commands.name: create_gameobject
commands.description: Create an empty GameObject or a built-in primitive (cube/sphere/capsule/cylinder/plane/quad) in the active scene.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name for the new GameObject. Defaults to 'GameObject' (or the primitive name).

parameters.name: primitive
parameters.description: Optional primitive type: cube, sphere, capsule, cylinder, plane, quad. Omit for an empty GameObject.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Optional parent handle (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath). The new object becomes a child of it.

commands.name: create_gameobjects
commands.description: Batch-create N empty GameObjects or primitives in one call. Optional positions/rotations/scales are arrays of [x,y,z] (length must equal count). Returns the created identities.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Base name. With count>1 and no explicit names, objects are suffixed Name1..NameN.

parameters.name: primitive
parameters.description: Optional primitive type: cube, sphere, capsule, cylinder, plane, quad. Omit for empty GameObjects.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Optional parent handle. Every created object becomes a child of it.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: How many GameObjects to create. Default 1.

parameters.name: positions
parameters.description: Local positions, one [x,y,z] per object. Length must equal count when supplied.

parameters.name: rotations
parameters.description: Local Euler rotations (degrees), one [x,y,z] per object. Length must equal count when supplied.

parameters.name: scales
parameters.description: Local scales, one [x,y,z] per object. Length must equal count when supplied.

commands.name: set_serialized_field
commands.description: Set a serialized field on a component/asset. Supports primitives, enums, Vector/Color/Rect/Bounds, object references (value = an ObjectRef: asset by guid/fileId/path or scene object by instanceId/hierarchyPath), and array elements via 'name.Array.data[i]' (or 'name.Array.size' to resize).

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Reference to the component or asset to modify (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath). May be a GameObject when 'component' is given.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: SerializedProperty path, e.g. 'speed', 'settings.speed', or 'waypoints.Array.data[0]'.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: JSON value to assign. For object references pass an ObjectRef object (or null to clear). For enums pass the value name.

parameters.name: component
parameters.description: Component type name on the target GameObject (e.g. 'Rigidbody'). Use when 'target' is a GameObject; omit when 'target' is already a component handle.

commands.description: Read serialized fields of a component/asset. Returns each top-level field's name, type and value (object references are returned as re-usable handles). Pass 'field' to read a single SerializedProperty path. Pass format='value' to return just the value(s) — a token-efficient read for scalars.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Reference to the component or asset to read (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath). May be a GameObject when 'component' is given.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Optional single SerializedProperty path to read (e.g. 'speed' or 'items.Array.data[0]'). Omit to read all top-level fields.

parameters.name: component
parameters.description: Component type name on the target GameObject (e.g. 'Rigidbody'). Use when 'target' is a GameObject; omit when 'target' is already a component handle.

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Run multiple registered commands in one transactional request. Later ops can reference earlier results with "$<id-or-index>.<jsonPath>" (e.g. "$0.instanceId"; "$$" escapes a literal '$'). transactional=true (default) groups every op into one Undo step and reverts all applied ops if any op fails; commands that mutate outside the Undo system (asset/file/settings writes) are rejected unless transactional=false. on_error=abort|continue (continue forces transactional=false); dry_run validates without mutating; time_budget_ms (default 50000) bounds execution — when exceeded the remaining ops are skipped and a transactional batch rolls back (submit long batches with "job": true). Excludes build, switch_build_target, package_*, editor_play/stop/pause, recompile, eval, eval_file, run_script, menu, open_scene/create_scene, async commands (run_tests/list_tests), runtime-only commands, and nested batch.

parameters.name: operations
parameters.description: Ordered operations to run; each is { id?, command, params }. Max 200.

parameters.name: transactional
parameters.description: Group all ops into one Undo step and revert every applied op if any op fails. Default true. Forced false when on_error=continue. Rejects commands whose mutations Undo cannot revert (asset/file/settings writes).

parameters.name: on_error
parameters.description: abort (default): stop at the first failing op. continue: run every op, collecting per-op errors (forces transactional=false).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Validate command names, parameters, reference topology and excluded commands without mutating anything.

parameters.name: result_fields
parameters.description: Optional per-op result projection: map of op id-or-index -> array of result field paths to keep (context economy).

parameters.name: time_budget_ms
parameters.description: Cooperative time budget for the whole batch in milliseconds (default 50000, max 3600000). Checked before each op after the first; when exhausted the remaining ops are skipped and a transactional batch rolls back. Use "job": true for long batches.

schema.title: batch

Excludes build, switch_build_target, package_*, editor_play/stop/pause, recompile, eval, eval_file, run_script, menu, open_scene/create_scene, async commands (run_tests/list_tests), runtime-only commands, and nested batch.

id.description: Optional id for referencing this op's result from a later op ("$<id>.<field>"). Unique within the batch; must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$ (not purely numeric, no dots).

command.description: Name of the registered command to run.

params.description: Parameters for the command. String values may reference a prior op's result: "$<id-or-index>.<jsonPath>".

operations.description: Ordered operations to run; each is { id?, command, params }. Max 200.

transactional.description: Group all ops into one Undo step and revert every applied op if any op fails. Default true. Forced false when on_error=continue. Rejects commands whose mutations Undo cannot revert (asset/file/settings writes).

on_error.description: abort (default): stop at the first failing op. continue: run every op, collecting per-op errors (forces transactional=false).

dry_run.description: Validate command names, parameters, reference topology and excluded commands without mutating anything.

result_fields.description: Optional per-op result projection: map of op id-or-index -> array of result field paths to keep (context economy).

time_budget_ms.description: Cooperative time budget for the whole batch in milliseconds (default 50000, max 3600000). Checked before each op after the first; when exhausted the remaining ops are skipped and a transactional batch rolls back. Use "job": true for long batches.
